result: The best of nine prespecified candidates was 4096/8192 fixed fusion with short weight 0.2: 72.223842% accuracy, a 0.258444 percentage-point gain over long8192. Both development families improved, but the gain is below the prespecified 0.5-point threshold; no candidate is eligible.
insight: Increasing the short window from 2048 to 4096 improves all matched single/fusion comparisons. Its extra benefit over the 8192 baseline is small in the tested settings, and the confidence-margin rule does not improve on the fixed 0.2 mixture. This supports more reliable short-window evidence but does not establish a useful fusion advantage under the acceptance criterion.
